arguments.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: ONE complete transparent SW idle base character for a 2D game, not a sheet or animation.
Input 1 is the sole pose, direction, perspective and full-canvas registration reference: original SW idle frame 21, complete 128x128 canvas enlarged nearest-neighbor 8x to 1024x1024. Input 2 is an unregistered first-cell extraction from a rejected generated sheet, used ONLY for this same character's modern identity, clothing, materials and candidate texture design. Do not adopt Input 2's framing or its erroneous exposed far hand.

Create one full-body high-definition modern armored hero in EXACTLY the original frame-21 SW stance and elevated front-three-quarter camera, looking diagonally toward screen lower-left. Keep the same adult East Asian male identity, short black hair, black fitted technical cloth, compact silver/graphite armor, paired subdued red shoulder caps, forearm guards, small side plates, separate knee/shin armor, and practical dark gloves and boots as Input 2. Preserve its clothing construction, proportions and restrained upper-left lighting as closely as possible; no new emblem, weapon, backpack, cape, cyan core, or redesign. Do not turn to straight S/front and do not mirror an SE pose.

Primary correction: the screen-left FAR hand must be naturally occluded by the intervening torso/forearm in this SW view, not an independent exposed palm or dangling fingers beside the screen-left hip as in Input 2. Show a coherent far sleeve/forearm ending behind the body, with normal overlap and thickness. Do not flatten, shrink, erase, amputate or cut a transparent hole where a palm would be. Do not invent a hidden joint or rotate the whole torso just to conceal the hand. The screen-right NEAR hand remains clearly visible at the side, with normal glove and finger silhouette.

Composition: retain the complete square reference canvas and deliberate empty margins, NOT a tight centered portrait. Requested output 1024x1024. Native canvas is 128x128, actor origin (16,64), scale 8 output px per native px; origin therefore (128,512). Approximate visible-surface coordinates in native pixels: crown (40.5,15), near-hand end (48,57), upper/left boot leading endpoint (32,77.5), lower boot leading endpoint (38,87). Their corresponding requested output positions are about (324,120), (384,456), (256,620), (304,696). The boots retain about 6 native pixels horizontal and 9.5 native pixels vertical stagger. These are visible cloth/hair/shoe surface observations with about 1-2 native pixels uncertainty, NOT inferred skeleton or floor contacts. Respect Input 1's overall head/shoulder/hand/boot arrangement while rendering the modern wardrobe. Original robe edges are not bones: do not copy the old robe, hair color or its checkerboard cast shadow.

Scale/context distinction: Input 2 is 576x725, visible main figure bbox approximately x216..397, y121..613, with complete weak-alpha surroundings retained. Its previous diagnostic body scale was about 6.62 input pixels per native pixel; that extraction has NO approved canvas origin. Do not fill the output canvas using that crop bbox. Use Input 1 for placement and pose; Input 2 for identity/material only.

Output exactly one complete character with real transparent background, all hair, near hand and both boots intact; no ground, cast shadow, grid, labels, coordinate markers, border, text or watermark. Natural anti-aliased transparency. No additional figures or four-phase variants.
